StmtSimple.StatementText: SELECT dbo.item.icode, dbo.item.customicode, dbo.item.name, localitemname = dbo.item.localitemname, dbo.item.manfcode, dbo.item.packunits, dbo.item.purprice, SalePrice = CASE (SELECT G.SalePriceInItemList FROM Groups G WHERE G.GroupCode = 2) WHEN 2 THEN dbo.item.saleprice2 WHEN 3 THEN dbo.item.saleprice3 WHEN 4 THEN dbo.item.saleprice4 WHEN 5 THEN dbo.item.saleprice5 ELSE dbo.item.saleprice END, dbo.Manufacturer.name, genericname=(select name from genericitem where genericitem.genericcode=item.genericcode), stock = (select sum(dbo.godowndetail.currqty) from dbo.godowndetail where dbo.godowndetail.icode = dbo.item.icode), sstock = CASE WHEN (SELECT salegodownstrategy FROM Groups Where GroupCode = 2) = 2 THEN (select sum(dbo.godowndetail.currqty) from dbo.godowndetail where dbo.godowndetail.icode = dbo.item.icode and dbo.godowndetail.gcode = item.GCode) ELSE (select sum(dbo.godowndetail.currqty) from dbo.godowndetail, (SELECT DISTINCT GCode From GroupAllowedGodown WHERE GroupAllowedGodown.GroupCode = 2 AND GroupAllowedGodown.Module = 1) T where dbo.godowndetail.icode = dbo.item.icode and dbo.godowndetail.gcode = T.GCode) END, pstock = CASE WHEN (SELECT purchasegodownstrategy FROM Groups Where GroupCode = 2) = 2 THEN (select sum(dbo.godowndetail.currqty) from dbo.godowndetail where dbo.godowndetail.icode = dbo.item.icode and dbo.godowndetail.gcode = item.GCode) ELSE (select sum(dbo.godowndetail.currqty) from dbo.godowndetail, (SELECT DISTINCT GCode From GroupAllowedGodown WHERE GroupAllowedGodown.GroupCode = 2 AND GroupAllowedGodown.Module = 3) T where dbo.godowndetail.icode = dbo.item.icode and dbo.godowndetail.gcode = T.GCode) END, Packing = dbo.itempacking.name, packingdesc=item.packingdesc, dbo.item.icatcode, dbo.item.iccode, dbo.item.packcode, dbo.item.itemalertcode, itemalerttypecode = (select ia.itemalerttypecode from itemalert ia where ia.itemalertcode = item.itemalertcode), dbo.item.restricted, dbo.item.location, transitstock=item.transitstock, BGColor = (SELECT IA.BGColor FROM ItemAlert IA WHERE IA.ItemAlertCode = dbo.item.itemalertcode) FROM dbo.item LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.itempacking ON (dbo.item.packcode = dbo.itempacking.packcode), dbo.Manufacturer WHERE dbo.item.Active = 1 and dbo.Manufacturer.manfcode = dbo.item.manfcode ORDER BY dbo.item.name;
